"""Run only the copied project adapter and its CPU public-behavior tests."""
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import wave
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from train.teacher_media import prepared_teacher_audio

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
started = time.monotonic()
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report = {
    "started_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "adapter_commit": "ec2fbdcc813552dfeb2d83d6f381cd5c21fcf6f1",
    "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
    "adapter_sha256": sha(base / "train/teacher_media.py"),
    "tests_sha256": sha(base / "tests/test_teacher_media.py"),
    "python": platform.python_version(),
    "python_executable": sys.executable,
    "pytest_version": importlib.metadata.version("pytest"),
    "platform": platform.platform(),
    "ffmpeg_version": subprocess.check_output(["ffmpeg", "-version"], text=True).splitlines()[0],
    "cpu_max": Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max").read_text().strip(),
    "memory_max": Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max").read_text().strip(),
    "heavy_lock": "/tmp/omnijev-cpu-heavy.lock",
    "ffmpeg_codec_threads": 1,
    "gpu_used": False,
    "model_loaded": False,
    "environment_modified": False,
    "exit_code": None,
}
try:
    source = base / "owned-synthetic-6ch-48000hz.wav"
    with wave.open(str(source), "wb") as stream:
        stream.setparams((6, 2, 48000, 0, "NONE", "not compressed"))
        stream.writeframes(b"\x00\x00" * 1548000 * 6)
    before = sha(source)
    assert before == "2c9c29e6658c591569a81c3057b7c9eb3cdb6987c94f479a853d73cb4daae04a"
    temporary = base / "temporary"
    temporary.mkdir()
    marker = temporary / "unrelated-user-file"
    marker.write_bytes(b"preserve")
    with prepared_teacher_audio(source, temp_parent=temporary) as output:
        with wave.open(str(output), "rb") as stream:
            pcm = stream.readframes(480001)
            metadata = {"channels": stream.getnchannels(), "sample_rate": stream.getframerate(),
                        "sample_width": stream.getsampwidth(), "frames": stream.getnframes(),
                        "full_pcm_bytes": len(pcm), "pcm_sha256": hashlib.sha256(pcm).hexdigest()}
        assert (metadata["channels"], metadata["sample_rate"], metadata["sample_width"], metadata["frames"]) == (1, 16000, 2, 480000)
        assert len(pcm) == 960000
        report["conversion"] = {"source_seconds": 32.25, "source_channels": 6,
                                "source_rate": 48000, "source_bytes": source.stat().st_size,
                                "source_sha256_before": before, "output_bytes": output.stat().st_size,
                                "output_sha256": sha(output), "output": metadata}
    assert not output.exists() and list(temporary.iterdir()) == [marker]
    try:
        with prepared_teacher_audio(source, temp_parent=temporary) as failed_output:
            assert failed_output.is_file()
            raise RuntimeError("owned consumer failure")
    except RuntimeError as error:
        assert str(error) == "owned consumer failure"
    else:
        raise AssertionError("consumer failure was not observed")
    assert not failed_output.exists() and list(temporary.iterdir()) == [marker]
    assert marker.read_bytes() == b"preserve" and sha(source) == before
    report["conversion"]["source_sha256_after"] = sha(source)
    report["success_and_consumer_exception_cleanup"] = True
    report["unrelated_file_preserved"] = True
    command = [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-c", "/dev/null", "--confcutdir", str(base),
               str(base / "tests/test_teacher_media.py"), "-q"]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=base, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    report["tests"] = {"command": command, "exit_code": result.returncode,
                       "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}
    assert result.returncode == 0 and "8 passed" in result.stdout and "skipped" not in result.stdout
    report["exit_code"] = 0
except Exception as error:
    report["exit_code"] = 1
    report["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)[:500]}
    raise
finally:
    report["completed_utc"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    report["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
    (base / "linux-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)
